newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish bonds end flat, markka steady vs mark.
newsitem.headline: Finnish bonds end flat, markka steady vs mark.

text.p: Markkka bonds ended steady on Wednesday after a very quiet session ahead of the Ascension Day holiday on Thursday, and trade was was expected to be subdued on Friday as well, dealers said.
"Germany has been quiet, and so have we," one dealer said.
The long-bond spread over Germany ended steady at 37 basis points. The only noticeable movement in yields was in the March FRA which fell three basis points from Tuesday's closing level.
The thinly traded markka ended steady versus the mark after DEM/FIM bobbed in a tight 3.0100-3.0160 range, as the market focussed on the Swedish crown's strength against the mark.
Forex dealers were reluctant to predict the markka's trend for Friday, the only remaining trading day of the week, saying it "was too far away."

With few significant overseas indicators in sight, the market would begin looking ahead to the U.S. Federal Reserve's May 20 FOMC meeting and the French general elections at the end of the month, dealers said.
